definitions.explanation: Having a large quantity or variety; well-supplied.

examples.japanese: {経験|けいけん}が{豊富|ほうふ}な{人|ひと}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We're looking for someone with rich experience.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{資源|しげん}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This region is rich in resources.

examples.japanese: {豊富|ほうふ}な{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{自慢|じまん}です。
examples.english: We pride ourselves on our abundant selection.

notes:
USAGE: {豊富|ほうふ} emphasizes both quantity and quality, often implying a rich variety.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{豊富|ほうふ}な〜 (abundant ~)
・〜が{豊富|ほうふ} (~ is abundant)
・{経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in experience)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{経験|けいけん}が{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in experience)
・{資源|しげん}が{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in resources)
・{知識|ちしき}が{豊富|ほうふ} (knowledgeable)
・{栄養|えいよう}が{豊富|ほうふ} (nutritious)
・{バラエティー}に{豊富|ほうふ} (wide variety)
